title: "penguin_analysis_demo"

## Quarto

Quarto enables you to weave together content and executable code into a finished document. To learn more about Quarto see <https://quarto.org>.

```{r}

library(tidyverse)
library(palmerpenguins)
```

## How many penguins in the dataset for each species?

```{r}
dataset <- penguins
dataset |>
  group_by(species) |>
  summarise(
    count = n()
  )
```

## Body Mass by Species

```{r}
dataset |>
  ggplot(
    aes(x = species, y = body_mass_g)
  ) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(x = species, y = body_mass_g, fill = species)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Body Mass by Penguin Species",
    x = "Species Name",
    y = "Body Mass"
  )
```

## Bill Depth by Species

```{r}
dataset |>
  group_by(species) |>
  summarise(
    count = n(),
    beak_depth = mean(dataset$bill_depth_mm, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```
